scope: 44 repository tests including 8 new case-record checks
case_invariants: initialization does not invent confirmed choices or approval
mixed direction selection references existing IDs
rendered status requires a retained preview or export
replay claims need recorded run evidence
initialization refuses to overwrite an existing record

independent_forward_test.method: independent agent with skill and repository access, no inherited conversation
independent_forward_test.side_effect_scope: read-only repository; no real user questions, rendering or external services

cases.synthetic_request: 我想要书籍主题的周历，先帮我探索一下。
cases.observed: Proposed visible whole-direction studies with explicit sample/default choices; did not infer a book list or selected style.
cases.execution_limit: No artwork was rendered in this test.

cases.synthetic_request: 如果用户想做书籍周历，我们需要哪些产品能力？
cases.observed: Stayed in discussion mode and separated existing tools/samples from missing capabilities; did not open a personal design case.

cases.synthetic_request: 这一版我喜欢七天等宽的排法，帮我把书的图片缩小一点，右边加大笔记区。
cases.observed: Retained the equal-column intent, scoped the edits and recognized that the parent source was unavailable; did not substitute an old study or inherit overall approval.
cases.execution_limit: No source design was provided, so no revision was produced.

narrow_followups: Clarified locating the current source before requesting a missing parent version.
Clarified the minimum first-study record to avoid excessive preparation before visual work.

limitations: Workflow routing and record integrity are checked; aesthetic quality is unvalidated.
No general theme-to-layout generator or online editor was implemented.
Chinese typography and book content curation remain separate capability work.
